reason: Four preserved attempts show that short away windows can end before one twenty-run driving condition finishes; preserve complete independent conditions rather than restarting the entire suite
execution: Use the existing compare-builds.py --conditions argument for one complete condition per controller; parked first, then driving if foreground authorization remains active
safeCheckpoint: Only a terminal completed controller with complete freshly calibrated and independently validated candidate comparison; no partial run, successful candidate prefix, or calibration/holdout prefix may be carried forward
reuseRequirements: Both source app/build identities and collector identity match this plan exactly
All acknowledged capture payloads pass the existing loader and completed-run contract
Regenerate calibration, independent holdout and candidate comparison through the actual CLI and require exact report equality
Condition comparison is improved or no detectable change, with no regression in any protected metric or segment
Every owned-process cleanup receipt passes and exact task-owned processes are gone
All available hardware/browser/tier/viewport/seed conditions match the intended recorded fixed-tier comparison; changes require new qualification rather than relabelling
interruption: Preserve the failed attempt unchanged; repeat only its unfinished condition in a new reserved window with fresh calibration and holdout
finalAcceptance: Require both complete conditions for these exact A/B identities, regenerate their reports and combine using the existing suite_verdict; retain CPU-cost and frame-delivery claim limits
limits: No shortened workload, fewer independent runs, wider thresholds, reused incomplete stage, changed policy or accepted mobile/Auto claim
failurePolicy: A completed regressed or invalid comparison stops acceptance; never retry unchanged code merely to obtain a passing verdict. A new source revision requires new source-bound qualification and full conditions.
